product_metadata.title: Gel Thumb Support Glove
features: Protect and relieve painful thumb joints with this soothing support.
Thumb support features a built-in gel cushion that fits snugly over your lower thumb joint to provide gentle compression, support and soothing warmth to help ease pain.
Lightweight and flexible construction won't restrict your activities.
Fits right or left hand and most wrists.
